description: This file defines the ConnectContactLensClient class for interacting with the Amazon Connect Contact Lens service via the AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for listing real-time contact analysis segments synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: ConnectContactLensClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Connect Contact Lens service, extending AwsClient to inherit generic AWS client functionality.

methods.name: listRealtimeContactAnalysisSegments
methods.description: Method to synchronously list real-time contact analysis segments.

methods.name: listRealtimeContactAnalysisSegmentsAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously list real-time contact analysis segments using promises.
